About.heroDescription: Norton University's official digital library — a modern, accessible hub for academic books, journals, and research resources, built with passion by students, for students.
About.howStartedDescription: In 2018, E-Library Norton was born from a simple idea: every student at Norton University deserves free, instant access to quality academic resources. Starting with just 2,000 digital books, we've grown into a comprehensive platform serving thousands of students across all faculties.
About.milestone2018: E-Library Norton launched with 2,000 digital books
About.milestone2020: Expanded to 8,000 titles across all faculties
About.missionDescription: To provide every Norton University student with free, instant access to a world-class digital library that supports academic excellence and lifelong learning, bridging the gap between knowledge and opportunity.
About.missionFeatureFree: 100% free for all registered NU students
About.visionDescription: To become Southeast Asia's leading university digital library, setting the standard for accessible, innovative, and AI-enhanced academic resources — empowering the next generation of Cambodian scholars and professionals.
About.valueOpenDescription: We believe knowledge should be accessible to every student, regardless of financial barriers.
About.valueInnovationDescription: Leveraging modern technology to bring the library experience to the digital age.
About.valueCommunityDescription: Building a community of learners who support and inspire each other.
About.valueExcellenceDescription: Curating only the highest-quality, peer-reviewed academic resources.
About.stackDescription: Carefully chosen technologies that make the platform fast, reliable, and scalable for every student.
About.teamDescription: The advisor and dedicated developers building the platform.
About.advisorBio: Guiding the team with expertise in software engineering and academic research methodologies.
About.samnangBio: You build it, you run it.
About.ctaDescription: Have a suggestion, a question, or want to collaborate? We'd love to hear from you. Join thousands of students exploring the library today.

Contact.faqDescription: Quick answers to the most common questions about our E-Library.
Contact.faqAccessQuestion: How do I get access to the E-Library?
Contact.faqAccessAnswer: All enrolled Norton University students automatically receive access. Simply sign in with your student email and create a password to get started.
Contact.faqDownloadQuestion: Can I download books for offline reading?
Contact.faqDownloadAnswer: Yes! Most of our digital books support offline reading. Look for the download icon on any book's detail page to save it to your device.
Contact.faqReportQuestion: How do I report a missing or broken resource?
Contact.faqReportAnswer: Use the contact form on this page or email support@norton.edu.kh with the book title and a description of the issue. We'll resolve it within 24 hours.
Contact.faqLimitQuestion: Is there a limit on how many books I can borrow?
Contact.faqLimitAnswer: Digital borrowing has no limits — read as many books as you like simultaneously. Physical book loans follow the library's standard policy of 5 books at a time.
